new_part_types.name: Uruk-hai halberd (long pole with axe blade)

notes: Booklet has two numbered bags: bag 1 = Uruk-hai catapult wagon + 4 Uruk-hai; bag 2 = castle wall section, Eomer on horse, Rohan archer. Both are built. The two models are genuinely separate builds (p2: bag 1 and bag 2 each give their own model), so the catapult wagon group and the castle group are intentionally not joined to each other; the minifigures are tied to their own model by contact edges (Uruk-hai next to the wagon, horse on the castle base, archer on the roof), which is how they are posed on p1/p27/p67.
Wagon is built in order: base/chassis (b1-b26), rear wedge sub-assembly (b27-b32, step 12), then the separate catapult arm (b33-b70, p16-25) which fits onto the upright axle b21 (step 15).

Element ID matching: where the catalogue had the ID I used it. Inventory IDs not in the catalogue became new types; names/dimensions are guessed from the parts-box pictures (e.g. 4211349 vs 4651063 corner-brick variants, 4521950 green 1x3 (may be 1x4), 6005735 long dark-red plate, 4579690 large dark-red plate, 4227398 dark-grey plate 2x4).

Uruk-hai weapons corrected from the parts page: 4222798 = halberd (2x), 6002758 = black sword (2x), 6002757 = shield (2x). Halberd figures (copies 1-2) wear helmet + chest armour 4617227; sword-and-shield figures (copies 3-4) hold sword in one hand and shield in the other; copy 3 has black hair 4637225 instead of a helmet.
Parts page lists 2x plate 1x6 (4211438) but only one placement is shown (step 26); the second (b244) is assumed to sit on the roof plates symmetrically and is joined to both roof plates.
Several catalogue entries (e.g. 241926, 4568951, 4538950, 4211002, 6000606) carry names that do not match the picture exactly; I trusted the Element ID from the inventory pages.

Exact stud-to-stud adjacency for the castle wall (steps 3-31) cannot be read from the small isometric pictures. Each brick is joined to one or two supporting bricks/plates that it visibly sits on or beside; some supports (especially steps 11-18 and 24-31) are best guesses, but every piece is present and connected.

Port kinds follow the compatibility table: minifig torso neck/hip = stud, head neck / legs hip / helmet / cape / armour / quiver = anti-stud, head top = stud, torso hand = clip, held items = bar. Where several parts share one catalogue port (cape/armour/quiver on the torso neck, flags on the staff, flame on the torch holder, bolt rods in the Technic brick) the extra edges use no named port.
Technic brick 1x10 (b3, b4) has nine pin-hole ports so wheel axle pins, blue pins and the lower axle each use a different hole.

Both launched bolts (rods) are modelled sliding in Technic brick b58 with no named port. The two black Technic pins of step 35 (b224, b225) are placed one in each end Technic brick (b103, b104) as an assumption.
Catapult arm hinge chain: clip plate 4517925 hinge -> 4296142 hinge.1; 4296142 hinge.2 -> hinge plate 4210884. Claw sub-build: bush on claw axle port, cone on claw pin, rod in cone.

graph_initial.title: LEGO 9471 Uruk-hai Army
notes: Booklet has two numbered bags: bag 1 = Uruk-hai catapult wagon + 4 Uruk-hai; bag 2 = castle wall section, Eomer on horse, Rohan archer. Both built; the bag-3 'spill and sort' pages (p3) are not part of the build.
Wagon is built in order: base/chassis (b1-b26), rear wedge sub-assembly (b27-b32, step 12), then the separate catapult arm (b33-b70, p16-25) which fits onto the upright axle b21 (step 15).

Element ID matching: where the catalogue had the ID I used it. Inventory IDs not in the catalogue became new types; names/dimensions for those are guessed from the parts-box pictures. Examples: 4211349 vs 4651063 (two corner-brick variants), 4521950 (green 1x3, may be 1x4), 6005735 (long dark-red plate), 4579690 (large dark-red plate), 4227398 (dark-grey plate 2x4).
Several catalogue entries (e.g. 241926, 4568951, 4538950, 4211002, 6000606) carry names that don't match the picture exactly; I trusted the Element ID from the inventory pages.

Exact stud-to-stud adjacency for the castle wall (steps 3-31) cannot be read from the small isometric pictures. Each brick is joined to one or two supporting bricks/plates that it visibly sits on or beside; some supports (especially for steps 11-18 and 24-31) are best guesses, but every piece is present and connected.

The rods (antenna rods b-bolt) of the catapult are shooting bolts (p24-25): drawn as sliding in the Technic brick b58 holes. The Technic brick b58 is treated as having a single catalogue pin-hole port even though both bolts pass through it.
The two black Technic pins (b224, b225, step 35) are both modelled into the left Technic brick b103 as shown by the arrow on p66.
Axle b22 (lower) is assumed to pass through the bent connector b23 and into a hole of Technic brick b3; the upper axle b21 carries the arm.
Uruk-hai figures use a repeat: copies 1-2 helmet+armour+halberd; copy 3 black hair + sword/shield, no helmet/armour; copy 4 helmet + sword/shield, no armour (from p4-5, p27).
Hair piece 4637225 and minifig-part IDs (torsos, heads, legs, helmets) are identified from the parts list order; Rohan archer's torch is on the wall (b222/b223) rather than in his hand per p65-67.
Archer figure rests on the roof plate (contact only); Eomer sits on the horse saddle with the sword tucked into the saddle (p30).

final_issue_list: the build is 2 separate groups of pieces; connect them unless the booklet really builds separate models
